Remaining unverified items: the implementation of the load-gate hold (the provider code in the add-on hold feature) and whether the linked addon-hold.md exists and is accurate; neither is in the supplied evidence. I reviewed the surrounding base text, which describes pre-existing behavior in the native MiMo, Flash-Next, Flint and prefix-cache (T-041) sections, and found nothing in the supplied changed lines that alters those controls. No findings. I set needs_deeper_review=false because the change is documentation-only and the truncated row is low-risk, though the hold implementation belongs to other files' review.
